Proof in the paper: The single-crystal cell structural models for InNi, InNi2, InNi3, and In3Ni2 were built according to previous reports and the XRD results. (30,31) The geometry optimization and self-consistent field of the bulk In–Ni IMC convergence criterion were set as follows: energy = 10–6 eV and force = 0.001 eV/Å. The InNi (001), InNi2 (110), InNi3 (201), and In3Ni2 (110) surfaces were cut from the optimized cell and were modeled by four layers.
